WITH store_days AS (
  -- one row per physical store open on at least one day of 2024, with its open days in 2024, both ends included
  SELECT store_id,
         date_diff('day', GREATEST(opened_on, DATE '2024-01-01'),
                   LEAST(COALESCE(close_date, DATE '2024-12-31'), DATE '2024-12-31')) + 1 AS open_days
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web'
    AND opened_on <= DATE '2024-12-31'
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),
store_revenue AS (
  -- one row per store with an order in 2024: the net revenue of its lines, on the UTC days of 2024
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.net_revenue_eur, 0)) / SUM(d.open_days), 2)
FROM store_days AS d
LEFT JOIN store_revenue AS r ON r.store_id = d.store_id
